description:
Bind a lecture session to the Zoom meeting whose RTMS stream feeds it.

At least one of ``zoom_meeting_id`` or ``zoom_join_url`` is required. A join
link alone supplies the meeting number; giving both lets the owner bind a
meeting UUID while still sharing a clickable link.

zoom_join_url.description: https Zoom join link on a zoom.us/zoom.com host, shared with session members as a Join meeting button.
zoom_join_url.title: Zoom Join Url

zoom_meeting_id.description: Zoom meeting number or UUID reported in RTMS webhooks.
zoom_meeting_id.title: Zoom Meeting Id

title: StartZoomRtmsRequest
